metadata.Name: FQuAD2.0
metadata.Description: FQuAD2.0 is a French question answering dataset that extends FQuAD1.1 with additional unanswerable questions.
metadata.Paper Title: FQuAD2.0: French Question Answering and knowing that you know nothing
metadata.Venue Name: 2020 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
metadata.Abstract: This paper presents FQuAD2.0, a French question answering dataset that extends FQuAD1.1 with additional unanswerable questions. The dataset is designed to evaluate the ability of models to identify when a question is unanswerable. The paper describes the dataset collection process, the annotation protocol, and the evaluation metrics used to assess the performance of models on the dataset.
